title: Resolve Open Questions 1 and 8 before approval
text: Resolve Open Questions 1 and 8 before approval. AC6 requires every candidate to be swept or explicitly excluded, but spec-AC-compliance and per-finding-resolution remain undecided, so no valid current category list can satisfy the sweep precondition.
